## OAuth2 Migration Handoff — Billing Service

**From:** Benjamin Huffer
**Date:** 2026-08-03
**Branch:** `oauth-migration`
**Status:** In progress — do not deploy to production yet

### What's done
- Auth middleware updated to support OAuth2, merged to `oauth-migration`, unit tests passing.
- Token-refresh logic updated for OAuth2, merged to `oauth-migration`, unit tests passing.

### What's NOT done
- **3 downstream services** still call the old API-key auth endpoints and have not been migrated to OAuth2. *(List them here by name so the next person doesn't have to hunt — I didn't have the service names handy when writing this note.)*
- **Production config** has not been touched — still points at the old auth flow.
- **Old API keys have not been rotated.**

### ⚠️ Critical constraint — read before touching anything
**Do not rotate or revoke the old API keys until all three downstream services are migrated.** They still depend on the old auth endpoints. Rotating keys early will break those services with 401s in production.

### Suggested order of operations
1. Identify and migrate the three downstream services to use OAuth2 against the new middleware/token-refresh logic already merged.
2. Verify each service authenticates successfully end-to-end (not just unit tests — hit staging/prod-like endpoints).
3. Only once all three are confirmed migrated and working, update production config to fully cut over.
4. Only after production cutover is confirmed stable, rotate/revoke the old API keys.

### Contact
I'm out on vacation starting tomorrow morning for one week. [Add your preferred backup contact / on-call info / whether you're reachable for emergencies here.]
